questions.q: Explain how a monopoly could lead to market failure.

ideas.label: It restricts output and raises the price
So resources are misallocated, or P is above MC

questions.model: A monopoly restricts output and raises its price. Price is above marginal cost, so too few resources go into the good and there is a misallocation of resources.
questions.why: Link the firm's behaviour to what happens to resources.

tests.answer: It restricts output and charges a higher price, so resources are misallocated.
